name: How much does it cost to build a custom home in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What is the realistic all-in cost to build a custom home in Pasadena, including site work, permits, and design fees?
mainEntity.text: What is the realistic all-in cost to build a custom home in Pasadena, including site work, permits, and design fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pasadena, custom home costs are often higher than homeowners expect because the headline construction price does not include the full project budget. A typical custom build may start around the low-to-mid hundreds per square foot, but the all-in number rises once you add architecture, engineering, surveys, soils reports, permit fees, grading, utility upgrades, and finish selections. For a 2,000-square-foot home, the total can move well past seven figures, especially on a sloped lot or if the design includes luxury finishes. The best way to budget is to separate hard construction costs from soft costs and contingency. Ask for a line-by-line proposal that identifies site prep, foundation type, drainage, retaining walls, and allowance amounts for fixtures and finishes. That makes it easier to compare bids and avoid a project that looks affordable on paper but balloons during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home construction in Pasadena commonly falls around $400 to $600 per square foot, with higher-end or difficult sites costing more. A 2,000-square-foot home can land well above $1 million once design fees, permits, grading, utility work, and finish upgrades are included. Hillside and luxury builds often cost more.
